messages:
Alex: Hey all — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/14567 is blocked by failing stage CI. Need quick decision: merge hold + targeted rerun, or approve snapshot update? cc @maria @ryan
ci-bot: build #2487 failed on stage (shard 7). failing test: tests/integration/test_embed_index.py::TestShard7::test_reindex_timeout. Logs: https://ci.example.com/build/2487
Maria: looking... I saw this flake earlier this week on shard7, usually intermittent timeout around kv-compact step. If it's timing, targeted rerun is safest. Can you paste the failing trace?
Alex: paste log below — timeout during reindex step, retries exhausted.
```
E   TimeoutError: reindex step exceeded 120s
  File "/workspace/runtime/embed/reindex.py", line 243, in reindex_shard
    await self.kv_client.compact(prefix)
  File "/workspace/runtime/kv/client.py", line 88, in compact
    raise TimeoutError("KV compact timed out")
```
Alex: I also ran locally against a mini shard, couldn't reproduce within 5 runs. Diff from snapshot seems unrelated (no embedding shape changes).
Ryan: if snapshot diffs are small unrelated noise, don't update snapshot yet. Prioritize a targeted rerun on the failing shard and a canary run on latest dedicated infra. If it passes, we can merge.
Sam: I can kick the targeted rerun on shard 7 and run a canary on dedicated-1 in ~10m. Assigning to myself. FYI the rerun command: `./scripts/ci/targeted_rerun --pr 14567 --shards 7`
Alex: thanks sam — please post results. Also: if rerun fails consistently, we should bisect and consider a hotfix revert.
Sam: started targeted rerun (build #2488). I'll stream logs here when available.
ci-bot: triggered targeted rerun #2488 for PR 14567 on shards [7]. status: queued.
Maria: if #2488 still flakes, I can run a local debug session with extra logging on kv client. Might add a short sleep/backoff to compact to reduce pressure as a quick mitigation.
Ryan: approve merging after a successful rerun + green canary. I'll +1 on merge if rerun clean. :+1:
Alex: noted. Last ask: if anyone has time, please double-check that change in reindex backpressure code (PR 14567 hunk at embed/reindex.py lines ~220-260) — I added a futures gather to parallelize compacts, might be increasing kv load.
Sam: logs show rerun started, will update on pass/fail.
Alex: thanks — holding merge until we see #2488 result.
Sam: update: #2488 passed shard 7 and canary on dedicated-1 is green. CI shows all checks passing.
ci-bot: build #2488 succeeded (all shards green).
Ryan: good — with that I'm fine approving. Alex, feel free to merge when ready.
Alex: merging now. Thanks everyone for quick turnaround :tada:
